name: agent-monitor
description: A side pane (and a band above the prompt) tracking channel messages waiting for a reply, running tool calls and subagents, external dispatches, custom cards from your own commands, and the session itself.

channelNames.title: Channel names
channelNames.description: Display names for channel ids, as id=name pairs separated by commas (e.g. 123456=general,987654=ops). Empty shows <server> #<last 4 digits of the id>.

replyTools.title: Reply tools
replyTools.description: Comma-separated tool names that count as replying to a channel. Empty means any MCP tool whose name ends in __reply or __voice_reply, matched to its own server.

waitingAlertMinutes.title: Waiting alert (minutes)
waitingAlertMinutes.description: A message waiting this long without a reply turns the Inbox segment to the warning color and shows one toast.

longActionMinutes.title: Long action (minutes)
longActionMinutes.description: A tool call running this long is shown in the warning color.

contextWarnPercent.title: Context warning (%)
contextWarnPercent.description: Context usage at or above this suggests a restart and shows one toast each time it is crossed.

contextCriticalPercent.title: Context critical (%)
contextCriticalPercent.description: Context usage at or above this is shown in the error color.

dispatchCommand.title: Dispatch event command
dispatchCommand.description: A read-only command that prints dispatch events as JSONL, one event per line with event_type (DispatchStarted, DispatchHeartbeat, DispatchCompleted, DispatchFailed, DispatchCancelled, DispatchRejected), timestamp and a payload carrying dispatch_id. {since24h} is replaced with an RFC3339 time 24 hours ago. Empty hides the Dispatches section and runs nothing.

dispatchCommandPattern.title: Dispatch command pattern
dispatchCommandPattern.description: A regular expression; a Bash call whose command matches it is labelled dispatch -> <runtime>, the runtime taken from --runtime <x>. Empty recognises nothing.

runtimeNames.title: Runtime names
runtimeNames.description: Display names for runtime ids, as id=name pairs separated by commas (e.g. codex-cli=Codex). Empty shows the runtime id.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone for clock times in the pane (e.g. Europe/Berlin). Empty uses UTC.

customCards.title: Custom cards
customCards.description: Extra cards as TITLE=command pairs separated by ;; (the command runs without a shell, read-only, 10 s timeout). It prints one JSON object: {"summary": "one line", "items": [{"mark": "running|stalled|done|failed|idle|waiting|warn", "text": "...", "right": "..."}], "empty": "text when there are no items"}. Empty adds no cards.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the monitor pane when a session starts (the terminal seats it once it is wide enough).

wakePattern.title: Wake pattern
wakePattern.description: A regular expression marking prompts that woke the session (shown in the SESSION card). Empty counts scheduled and loop triggers.

collapsedCards.title: Collapsed by default
collapsedCards.description: Comma-separated card ids collapsed until you expand them (ids: inbox, running, dispatches, session, and each custom card's title in lower case with dashes).

customCardMaxItems.title: Custom card items
customCardMaxItems.description: Most items an expanded custom card lists; the rest fold into one +N more line.

paneMaxRows.title: Pane height (rows)
paneMaxRows.description: Rows the pane may use when the surface does not report its height. Past it, expanded cards are shortened first so every card's title stays visible.
